item.title: Artificial Intelligence in Learning and Development
item.content:encoded:
Sehoon Kim, University of Minnesota

Alexandre Ardichvili, University of Minnesota

Dae Seok Chai, Texas A&M University

This special issue advances scholarship on artificial intelligence's role in learning and development. It publishes conceptual, theoretical, and empirical studies examining how AI transforms formal and informal learning, workforce development, and organizational learning, contributing to human resource development theory and practice.

The issue reconceptualizes AI beyond a technological tool to address how it reshapes the purposes, processes, outcomes, and values of workplace learning. It encourages theory-building, critical examinations, cross-cultural insights, and rigorous methodologies, combining peer-reviewed scholarly papers with selected practice-oriented perspective papers reflecting current organizational AI applications.

Appel publié par European journal of training and development. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

Potential topics

  • Theoretical and conceptual frameworks for AI in learning and development
  • Role of HRD professionals and learning staff in AI-enabled systems
  • Effectiveness and impact of AI-driven learning interventions
  • Cross-cultural and international perspectives on AI integration in learning and development
  • AI, ethics, equity, and inclusion in learning and development
  • Practice-oriented perspectives on AI applications and organizational lessons

Timeline

  • January 8, 2026: Opening date for manuscripts submissions
  • December 31, 2026: Closing date for manuscripts submission
